buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The brand new latest model Advanced Life Support (Type-D) Ambulance and its accessories shall be quoted and supplied. The make and model of the Advanced Li fe Support (Type-D) Ambulance and its accessories should be clearly specified. 2. Payment condition:- 100% payment will be released within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of supply & final acceptance by RCC. 3. Delivery Place: - All items as per the supply order shall be delivered in Engine ering Division of Regional Cancer Centre at vendors risk & cost. 4. Delivery period:- All items as per the supply order shall be supplied to satisfac tion by RCC within 30 days from the date of supply order. If it is delayed, RCC will c harge a penalty of 0.05% of the order value per day for the first 30 days and thereaft er 0.06% per day. 5. Registration should be made in the name of Director, RCC-TVM 6. Warranty:- The successful bidder shall provide the standard warranty offered by the respective OE Ms for the chassis, ambulance body, medical equipment, accessories, and all other supplied components. The warranty for the chassis, including the engine, gearbox, transmission, and other OEM-fitted componen ts, shall be not less than three (3) years or 1,00,000 km, whichever occurs earlier, from the date of supply and final acceptance by RCC. If any spares are to be imported during warranty period, the cost, ins urance, freight, customs duty, clearance charges etc., shall be given by the vendor. 7. Service:- Prompt after sale service should be provided within 48 hours of request. 8. The rate quoted shall be per unit and landing price should be inclusive of Basic price and GST, Ins urance Charges (for 1 year) and Vehicle Registration & Lifetime Tax paid including delivery at site. 9. Training:- Necessary onsite training should be given to the concerned staff free of cost. 10. Any action on the part of the tenderer to influence anybody of the Institute will make his tender lia ble to rejection. 11. Companies/Firms who have been/are indulged in illegal bid rigging and cartelization, forged docum ent submission etc during the last 3 years and have been penalized by any government agencies such as C ompetition Commission of India (CCI), Government of Kerala etc will not be entertained for participating in Tender. Hence the vendor should upload an undertaking that we have not blacklisted/penalized by any Go vt. agencies for any reason in the technical documents of the e- tender. Format of Affidavit certifying that Entity / Promoter(s) /Director(s)/Partners of Entity are not blacklisted is attached with tender notice. 12. After the approval of contract, the successful tenderer shall arrange to submit an agreement in Ker ala stamp paper worth Rs.200/- and a security deposit of 5% of the total value of the order for the due fulfill ment of the contract within 15 days from the date of supply order. This deposit amount will be refunded on ly after the expiry of the contract successfully. If the agreement and security deposit is not submitted withi n 15 days from the date of supply order, RCC will charge an amount of Rs.200/- per day till the date of sub mission of documents. 13. Withdrawal or non-compliance of agreed terms and conditions after the exec

ution of agreement or issuance of Supply order will lead to invoking of penal provisio ns and may also lead to black listing/debarring of the successful tenderer. 14. Director of RCC reserves the right to accept or reject all or any tender at his sole discretion without assigning any reason. For legal purposes the cause of action will be deemed to have arisen in Trivandrum j urisdiction, Kerala state. . 2.
